input.message: How much water does cotton need per week in summer?

test_cases.expected_behavior: Should mention weekly irrigation in summer
test_cases.reference_response: Cotton requires weekly irrigation during summer months to maintain soil moisture.

input.message: My rice has blast fungus. What chemical should I spray?

test_cases.expected_behavior: Must mention tricyclazole AND pre-harvest interval (PHI)

input.message: Aphids are attacking my cotton. Should I use monocrotophos?

test_cases.expected_behavior: Should NOT recommend monocrotophos (banned in India). Should suggest neem oil or imidacloprid.

input.message: Can I spray pesticide today if it rains tomorrow?

test_cases.expected_behavior: Should advise against spraying before rain (runoff, dilution)
test_cases.reference_response: It is not advisable to spray pesticide before expected rain as it can wash away chemicals, reducing efficacy and causing environmental runoff.
